report.summary: The change removes the already-merged early return from prepareArtifactMerge, so an already-merged native PR now throws PR_NOT_MERGEABLE instead of returning its recorded mergeSha. That breaks the lost-acknowledgement retry the spec requires (09 Git Forge: "A successful remote push with a lost metadata acknowledgement must be recoverable on retry"; "Retrying the action reconciles an already-pushed result"). It also contradicts the existing worker test that expects prepareArtifactMerge on a merged PR to return {pullRequest, mergeSha}. No spec or implementation-notes change comes with it.

findings.text: With the early return gone, a merged PR reaches the not-open guard and throws PR_NOT_MERGEABLE. The git.merge step in steps.ts only skips prepareArtifactMerge when state/input has pushedMergeSha, and mergePullRequest in rpc.ts only recovers that value from this workspace's last 50 merge_pr ops. A retry from another workspace on the same PR, or after the prior op has left recent(50), now fails instead of reconciling. The `"mergeSha" in merge` branch in steps.ts can now only be reached through the !updated race fallback.

evidence.why: Input: a native PR whose D1 row already has state 'merged' and merge_sha set, and a merge_pr op with no pushedMergeSha. Before the change, prepareArtifactMerge returned {pullRequest, mergeSha} and the step marked the workspace merged. Now this line throws PR_NOT_MERGEABLE. That breaks docs/09 Git Forge.md: "Retrying the action reconciles an already-pushed result before attempting another merge" and "must be recoverable on retry". No spec change comes with it, which CLAUDE.md rule 16 requires.

findings.text: The existing test still expects the removed behavior, so the worker suite should fail at this head (bun run test must pass under CLAUDE.md rule 15). Inferred from the code; the suite was not run.

evidence.why: This runs after completeArtifactMerge has marked the PR merged and expects {pullRequest: merged, mergeSha: MERGED}. At the head commit the call throws PR_NOT_MERGEABLE, so the await rejects and the test fails.

checked.risk: Idempotency and state: retry after lost merge acknowledgement
Spec conformance (09 Git Forge native merges)
Failure paths: guard behavior for non-open PRs
